original_input_messages.content: I ordered a bag from Fictional Indigo Store on 3 October 2026 for Rs 1500. It has not been delivered. I want a refund. I have not described any evidence yet. What can I do?
Have you contacted the seller or received any response about the delivery?

I now have contradictory notes: one says the order date was 3 October 2026 and another says 8 October 2026. I cannot confirm which purchase date is correct. Withdraw my earlier confirmed date and leave it unknown; ask me to clarify rather than choosing a date. Seller and amount are unchanged.
